title: totalBudget() and runwaySeconds() use inconsistent accounting bases

classification.assetImpact: View-only. Monitoring dashboards and keeper logic cannot reconcile totalBudget and runwaySeconds due to mismatched accounting bases. No funds at risk.
attackPath: 1. Fund pool, let staker accrue unclaimed reward.
2. Read totalBudget() (includes balance + mintDebt, so includes earmarked user debt).
3. Read runwaySeconds() (uses rewardBudget + mintDebt, excludes earmarked debt).
4. Off-chain reconciliation fails; the two disagree by totalDebt.

justification: Low/QA. Pure view-consistency issue. No on-chain value effect. Fix is spec/NatSpec alignment plus a base choice. Classic QA-tier finding.
